d: The Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and the BJP are back together in Punjab, raising questions about whether their old alliance can regain its political strength. While the BJP is trying to expand beyond its traditional urban support base and strengthen its rural presence, two prominent farmer outfits have given the Akalis a boost. But will these changing political equations translate into votes and help the alliance revive its winning formula in Punjab? The Indian Express' Manraj Grewal Sharma explains. Watch
